name: Transport By Road 5
definition: Information related to the transportation of goods by road.

PlaceOfReceipt.name: Place Of Receipt
PlaceOfReceipt.definition: Identifies the location where the goods are received for transportation.

PlaceOfDelivery.name: Place Of Delivery
PlaceOfDelivery.definition: Identifies the location of delivery of the goods.

RoadCarrierName.name: Road Carrier Name
RoadCarrierName.definition: Identifies the party that is responsible for the conveyance of the goods from one place to another.

RoadCarrierCountry.name: Road Carrier Country
RoadCarrierCountry.definition: Country in which the carrier of the goods, for example, shipping company, is located or registered.

CarrierAgentName.name: Carrier Agent Name
CarrierAgentName.definition: Name of the carrier's (for example, shipping company's) agent that acts on behalf of the carrier and may be the issuer of transport documents relating to the underlying shipment.

CarrierAgentCountry.name: Carrier Agent Country
CarrierAgentCountry.definition: Country of registration of the carrier's (for example, shipping company's) agent that acts on behalf of the carrier and may be the issuer of transport documents relating to the underlying shipment.
